Definition (En): A map showing the shape and features of the land surface, typically including elevation, contour lines, and natural and man-made features.
A map showing property boundaries, land parcels, and ownership divisions.
A map showing administrative or political boundaries, such as regions, districts, or provinces.
A photographic image of the ground taken from an aircraft or other airborne platform.
An image of the Earth's surface captured by a satellite-based sensor.
A map showing the distribution of rock types, geological structures, and formations.
A map designed to display a particular subject or theme, such as the distribution of archaeological sites.
A hand-drawn or simplified map showing the layout of a site or area, not necessarily to scale.
A map produced in the past that documents historical geography, boundaries, or features no longer current.
A map showing the distribution and type of plant cover across an area, such as forest, grassland, or cultivated land.
A map showing the distribution, type, and characteristics of soils across an area.
A map showing the distribution or density of human population across an area.
A map designed for navigation, such as a nautical or aeronautical chart, showing features relevant to travel by sea or air.
A map designed for visitors, highlighting points of interest, facilities, and routes rather than technical survey detail.
A current map that reflects present-day geography, boundaries, or features, as distinct from a historical map.
